description: Single spline-CLT run on GPT-2 small at 1B tokens (~1 epoch over 7.81M sequences, seq_len=128, batch=64). Feature-match d_t=12288. Single seed. All tuning lives in common_gpt2_small_1b.json + gpt2_small_spline_feature_match_1b.json so the existing 4-variant paper_gpt2_small suite is untouched. Pair against the matched linear baseline from paper_gpt2_small at report time.
